title: Introducing Spyglass: Enhanced Insights for Everyone
summary: We are excited to announce the full launch of Spyglass, delivering powerful new capabilities to provide you with deeper, clearer insights.

title: Master Your Media: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files and media directly within the editor, giving you ultimate control over your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into recently shipped features, what's coming next, and exciting plans for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've delivered a significantly improved checkbox experience, making them larger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable for more efficient task management.

title: Seamless Teamwork in Your Editor
summary: Experience a more fluid and intuitive collaboration experience in the editor, making teamwork effortless.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: Now, all shared content from your connections is effortlessly discoverable through search and dedicated views, fostering richer collaboration.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce that Noeko's entire codebase is now open source, offering our community unprecedented transparency and the exciting opportunity to actively contribute to its evolution.

title: Global Language Accessibility
summary: Prepare for a truly global experience as Noeko introduces extensive support for diverse international languages.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Enhanced and New Themes
summary: Enjoy a more personalized and visually appealing experience with a complete refresh of our existing themes and the introduction of several exciting new styles.

title: Unlocking the Power of Your Constellation View
summary: Transform your Constellation view into an indispensable tool for discovery and workflow initiation with powerful new filtering and sharing capabilities.

title: Precision Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock unparalleled control over your knowledge with dynamic filters and flexible sorting, allowing you to instantly save and revisit your most valuable insights in custom collections.

title: Dynamic Note Linking
summary: We're introducing dynamic new ways to display and interact with linked content, making it easier than ever to organize your thoughts and structure your notes.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting & Premium Features
summary: We're empowering you with the flexibility to choose between self-hosting Noeko for greater control or leveraging our convenient cloud service, alongside new premium plans designed to scale with your ambitions.

title: Personalized Welcomes, Day or Night
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed welcomes as we update our greetings to accurately match your local time, day or night.

title: Efficient Tagged Item Management
summary: Take control of your tagged content with new direct actions, enabling effortless organization and modification of items directly from your tag views.

title: Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly import and analyze content from a wider array of sources, including websites, videos, and text, to enrich your knowledge base.
